capabilities: analyze selected text, the current note, or user input with DeepSeek
preview the AI response before using it
copy the response or insert it at the cursor or in reading mode
store the API key in Obsidian SecretStorage
follow the interface language with Chinese and English overrides
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. The README is bilingual (English and Chinese), warns against sending confidential note content, and states the plugin is free while DeepSeek bills API usage. Manual installation requires building with npm.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to get AI suggestions on note content, so users must leave the app or paste text into a separate AI tool.

relations.evidence: sends the text you explicitly choose to DeepSeek

requires.name: DeepSeek API balance for usage charges

summary: AI assistant that sends text you select in a note to DeepSeek, previews the response, and copies or inserts it into the note.
